faqs.a:
These provisions shall apply upon streets, highways, and other public ways or public
               areas, except that they shall not apply to any street or highway designated as a state
               highway within this municipality. These provisions shall also apply to any private
               parking lot that is either leased by the city for use as public parking lot, or that
               is otherwise subject to a written agreement with the city that allows for the use
               of private property for public parking purposes, so long as the lease or other written
               agreement allows for such enforcement.
(
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
